items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Joe Steele was a conservatory man. He and I went to the conservatory together, and I quit -- but he stayed there.

ctx.x: He's another one from Boston, huh?
That's right. Joe Steele was a conservatory man. He and I went to the conservatory together, and I quit -- but he stayed there. He was in the conservatory nine years.
